summary: Park and bush kerb on a quiet street; homes 27 m or more across the road.
reasons: Nearest home about 27 m, across road

best_section.where: South kerb on the bend, where the park and bush meet the road, about 40 m from the Moggill-side junction

drivers.seclusion: South side is open park and tree cover; homes sit on the far side of the road at 27 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a grass verge beside the kerb; a vehicle is already parked on this stretch, so a van fits.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Utes and cars park along this kerb; a van would not stand out.

flags: No Stopping on school days 2-4 pm; sign position along the kerb not shown
Low-lying: about 10 m elevation, a mapped waterway 32 m away
Construction site visible on the north side near 20-45 m
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the kerb; shade most of the day, mainly from the south and west.
cannot_judge: Exact start of the school no-stopping zone
